news.title: PFF NAMES 14-MAN PMNFT U15 FOR FIFA U15 WORLD CUP & FESTIVAL
news.lede: The Philippine Football Federation (PFF) has named the 14-player squad of the Philippine Under-15 Men’s National Football Team (PMNFT U15) for the inaugural FIFA U15 World Cup & Festival, which will be played in Baku, Azerbaijan, from October 24 to 30, 2026. The tournament uses an 8v8 format. FIFA requires national teams to field 14 players. “Representing the Philippines at the first FIFA U15 World Cup & Festival is a milestone for these young players and for our youth program.

news.lede: Chennai The inaugural edition of the FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival concluded in Baku, Azerbaijan, where 189 countries competed in a truly global tournament for over a week, between October 22 and 30. After nearly a 1000 matches, the FIFA under-15 World Cup ended with reigning senior men’s champion Spain winning the title. “Talent exists everywhere, but young players do not always have the same opportunities to test themselves internationally. news.title: Lionel Messi: A career in pictures
news.lede: Having started playing football in his native Argentina, Lionel Messi joined Barcelona's youth academy in 2001 at the age of 13. It wasn't long before he was promoted to the first team, making his La Liga debut in October 2004 at the age of 17. The following May he scored his first goal. His first title also came in his debut season, as Barcelona won La Liga in 2004-05.

news.title: Ronaldinho to make football comeback aged 46
news.lede: More than a decade after his last professional appearance, Brazilian superstar Ronaldinho is set for a comeback. The former world player of the year is to play in Italy’s third tier. While Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo are still playing at 39 and 41 respectively, most football fans thought Ronaldinho belonged to another footballing era. That all changed in June, when Italian Serie C club, Ravenna, announced that the former Barcelona, Paris Saint-Germain and AC Milan forward would play for them in the upcoming season.

news.title: Bermuda close out Under-15 World Cup on a winning note
news.lede: Bermuda concluded their participation at the Fifa Under-15 World Cup & Festival in Baku, Azerbaijan, on a high with a 2-0 triumph over Jordan in a Tier D finals match today. Adam Barritt and co-captain De’Ari Trott scored for Aaron Denkins's side to end the tournament on a bright note. It was Bermuda’s third victory in the knockout and placement stage, following wins over Macao and Bahrain. From ten matches played in the whole tournament, Bermuda finished with five wins and the same number of defeats to place 117th of 189.

news.title: Nigeria beat Mexico to set up U17 World Cup tie with Venezuela
news.lede: Captain Citlalli Reyes came close to breaking the deadlock on two occasions, seeing one effort deflected behind before goalkeeper Jane Ijirigho denied her in a one-on-one situation. Akeem Busari’s side gradually settled into the contest and made their growing confidence count five minutes before half-time. The Mexicans failed to deal with a searching delivery from Esther Stephen, allowing Umejiaku to seize possession and fire an unstoppable effort into the top corner. The breakthrough handed the Nigerian a slim advantage at the interval and shifted the momentum firmly in their favour.
